## Study design

**Case-control study**

Detected from abstract keywords. Evidence: case-control (abstract keyword).

## Key results

- CER (control event rate): 0.3%
- EER (experimental event rate): 4.9%
- ARI (absolute risk increase): 4.6 percentage points (95% CI 4.3 to 5.0)
- RRI (relative risk increase): 1640.2%
- NNH 22 (95% CI 21–24)

Notes on these numbers:

- A case-control study samples on the outcome, so the proportions exposed among cases and among controls are not risks, and an ARR, NNT or NNH cannot be read from them. The route that holds is the odds ratio the study reports, applied to a baseline risk you choose.

### Internal validity

| # | Item | Verdict |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Was one explicit definition of a case applied to everyone considered, using the same kind of evidence for each person? | — |
| 2 | Do the controls come from the population that produced the cases, so that a control who developed the condition would have entered the study as a case? | — |
| 3 | Was exposure established for cases and controls from the same source, ideally from records made before anyone knew who would become a case? | — |
| 4 | Were steps taken to stop knowledge of who was a case from shaping the exposure information, on the part of both the interviewer and the participant? | — |
| 5 | Were the obvious competing explanations handled by matching or by adjustment, and was any matching then carried through into the analysis? | — |
| 6 | Did a similar and reasonably high share of the cases and of the controls who were approached agree to take part? | — |
| 7 | Did the exposure clearly come before the condition started, rather than following early symptoms or the treatment those symptoms prompted? | — |
| 8 | Does the report keep to an odds ratio, rather than presenting a risk, a rate or a prevalence that this design cannot measure? | — |

### Applicability

Applicability is not internal validity. A trial can be conducted impeccably and still not transfer to the patient in front of you, and a trial with real methodological weaknesses can still be about exactly your patient. Nothing below is a verdict on how the study was run.

| # | Item | Verdict |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 9 | Are the cases, the population they came from and the exposure studied close enough to your own patients for the association to be worth acting on? | — |
